text: 创业板指跌超2%，沪指跌0.4%，深成指跌1.7%，农业、贵金属、油气、煤炭等方向跌幅居前，沪深京三市下跌个股近4200只。
text_en: The ChiNext Index fell more than 2%, the Shanghai Composite fell 0.4%, and the Shenzhen Component fell 1.7%, with agriculture, precious metals, oil and gas, and coal among the leading decliners. Nearly 4,200 stocks fell across the Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Beijing markets.
